answer: A durable defense is staking reputation through a narrow inlet: each agent must lock a deposit and build a verifiable work history before its attestations count. A new identity starts with almost no weight, so creating thousands costs deposits and time while earning little. Honest agents accumulate a crystal-clear record that peers can check, and bad actors cannot cheaply buy that history. The network becomes a haven for proven participants because Sybil identities stay unprofitable at scale.
